Bash(/tmp/fix-await.ps1 << 'PSEOF'
$files = @\(
    "C:\\Users\\Luiz\\netecia-app\\src\\app\\\(dashboard\)\\agenda\\page.tsx",
    "C:\\Users\\Luiz\\netecia-app\\src\\app\\\(dashboard\)\\clientes\\page.tsx",
    "C:\\Users\\Luiz\\netecia-app\\src\\app\\\(dashboard\)\\os\\page.tsx",
    "C:\\Users\\Luiz\\netecia-app\\src\\app\\\(dashboard\)\\contas\\page.tsx",
    "C:\\Users\\Luiz\\netecia-app\\src\\app\\\(dashboard\)\\contas-receber\\page.tsx",
    "C:\\Users\\Luiz\\netecia-app\\src\\app\\\(dashboard\)\\usuarios\\page.tsx",
    "C:\\Users\\Luiz\\netecia-app\\src\\app\\\(dashboard\)\\configuracoes\\page.tsx",
    "C:\\Users\\Luiz\\netecia-app\\src\\app\\\(dashboard\)\\perfil\\page.tsx",
    "C:\\Users\\Luiz\\netecia-app\\src\\components\\ServiceWorkerRegistration.tsx"
\)

foreach \($file in $files\) {
    if \(-not \(Test-Path $file\)\) {
        Write-Host "SKIP: $file not found"
        continue
    }
    $content = Get-Content $file -Raw -Encoding UTF8
    
    # Add await before api. calls that don't already have it
    $content = $content -replace '\(?<!await \)\(?<!await\\s\)\(api\\.[\\w]+\\.[\\w]+\\\(\)', 'await $1'
    $content = $content -replace '\(?<!await \)\(?<!await\\s\)\(api\\.getKPIs\\\(\)', 'await $1'
    $content = $content -replace '\(?<!await \)\(?<!await\\s\)\(api\\.gerarCobrancasAutomaticas\\\(\)', 'await $1'
    $content = $content -replace '\(?<!await \)\(?<!await\\s\)\(api\\.gerarContasReceber\\\(\)', 'await $1'
    
    # useCallback\(\(\) => { -> useCallback\(async \(\) => {
    $content = $content -replace 'useCallback\\\(\\\(\\\)', 'useCallback\(async \(\)'
    $content = $content -replace 'useCallback\\\(async async', 'useCallback\(async'
    
    # const funcName = \(\) => { -> const funcName = async \(\) => {
    $content = $content -replace 'const \(\\w+\) = \\\(\\\) => \\{', 'const $1 = async \(\) => {'
    $content = $content -replace 'const \(\\w+\) = \\\(\([^\)]+\)\\\) => \\{', 'const $1 = async \($2\) => {'
    
    # Fix useEffect: useEffect\(async \(\) => { is invalid in React
    $content = $content -replace 'useEffect\\\(async \\\(\\\) => \\{', 'useEffect\(\(\) => { \(async \(\) => {'
    $content = $content -replace 'useEffect\\\(\\\(\\\) => \\{ \\\(async \\\(\\\) => \\{', 'useEffect\(\(\) => { \(async \(\) => {'
    
    $content | Set-Content $file -Encoding UTF8 -NoNewline
    Write-Host "Fixed: $file"
}
PSEOF)

foreach \($file in $files\) {
    if \(-not \(Test-Path $file\)\) { continue }
    $content = Get-Content $file -Raw -Encoding UTF8
    
    # Fix 1: Remove async from functions that do NOT contain "await " in their body
    # We can't easily do this with regex across multi-line, so instead:
    # Revert ALL "const X = async \(...\) => {" to "const X = \(...\) => {"
    # Then re-add async ONLY where needed \(where body has await\)
    
    # Actually, simpler approach: just remove async from known non-async functions
    # by checking if the line before has await in the next few lines.
    # Too complex for regex. Let's just fix the specific patterns:
    
    # Fix: "await api.X.getAll\(\).filter\(" -> "\(await api.X.getAll\(\)\).filter\("
    $content = $content -replace 'await \(api\\.[\\w]+\\.getAll\\\(\\\)\)\\.\(filter|map|find|sort|slice|reduce|some|every|forEach|length\)', '\(await $1\).$2'
    
    # Fix: "await api.X.getAll\(\).length" - unlikely but possible
    
    $content | Set-Content $file -Encoding UTF8 -NoNewline
    Write-Host "Pass 2 fixed: $file"
}
PSEOF)
